data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: EN: N1MM-DXKeeper Gateway NOTE: Window title. "N1MM" and "DXKeeper" are product names - do not translate. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.

data.name: SettingsHeader
data.comment: EN: Settings NOTE: Heading of the settings section.

data.name: NetworkHeader
data.comment: EN: Network NOTE: Heading of the card holding ports and the multicast group.

data.name: ServicesHeader
data.comment: EN: Services NOTE: Heading of the card holding what DXKeeper should do with each logged QSO.

data.name: DiagnosticsHeader
data.comment: EN: Diagnostics NOTE: Heading of the card holding logging options.

data.name: LogCopy
data.comment: EN: Copy NOTE: Button copying the visible operation log to the clipboard.

data.name: LogClear

data.comment: EN: Copy the operation log to the clipboard

data.name: FailedQsoBarTitle
data.comment: EN: QSOs not delivered NOTE: Title of the warning bar shown when DXKeeper did not confirm one or more QSOs.

data.name: FailedQsoBarMessage
data.value: {0} QSOs z tohoto zasedání nebylo možné dodat do DXKeeper. Importovat {1} do DXKeeper, pak jej smazat - toto oznámení smaže, když je soubor pryč.
data.comment: EN: {0} QSOs from this session could not be delivered to DXKeeper. Import {1} into DXKeeper, then delete it — this notice clears when the file is gone. NOTE: {0} is a count, {1} is a filename. Do not translate the filename.

data.name: FailedQsoBarMessageOne
data.value: 1 QSO z tohoto zasedání nebylo možné dodat DXKeeper. Importovat {0} do DXKeeper, pak jej smazat - toto oznámení smaže, když je soubor pryč.
data.comment: EN: 1 QSO from this session could not be delivered to DXKeeper. Import {0} into DXKeeper, then delete it — this notice clears when the file is gone. NOTE: Singular form. {0} is a filename. Do not translate the filename.

data.comment: EN: Open File

data.name: OpenFolderButton
data.comment: EN: Open Folder

data.name: UdpPortLabel
data.comment: EN: UDP listening port: NOTE: Label for the port N1MM broadcasts QSO data to. "UDP" is a protocol name - do not translate.

data.name: UdpPortTip
data.value: UDP port, který N1MM Logger+ vysílání QSO XML na (standardní 12060)
data.comment: EN: UDP port that N1MM Logger+ broadcasts QSO XML to (default 12060) NOTE: Tooltip. Keep "N1MM Logger+", "UDP", "QSO" and "XML" in English.

data.name: MulticastLabel
data.comment: EN: Multicast group (optional): NOTE: Label for an optional IPv4 multicast group address.

data.name: MulticastPlaceholder
data.comment: EN: blank = no multicast NOTE: Placeholder shown inside the empty multicast text box.

data.name: MulticastTip
data.value: Nepovinné. Zanechat prázdné, pokud je program odesílání nakonfigurován pro odeslání do multicast skupiny (24.0.0.0 - 239.255.255.255). Unicast a vysílání jsou přijímány tak jako tak. Skupina se připojí na rozhraní, které vybere směrovací tabulka.
data.comment: EN: Optional. Leave blank unless the sending program is configured to send to a multicast group (224.0.0.0 - 239.255.255.255). Unicast and broadcast are received either way. The group is joined on the interface the routing table selects. NOTE: Tooltip. Do not translate the address range.

data.name: DxKeeperPortLabel
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper TCP base port: NOTE: Label. "DXKeeper" and "TCP" - do not translate.

data.name: DxKeeperPortTip
data.value: Jen tady. Nastavit DXKeeper: {0}. Brána posílá do základního portu + 1, což je port DXKeeper Ukazuje, že panel míří.
data.comment: EN: Read-only here. Set it in DXKeeper: {0}. The gateway sends to Base Port + 1, which is the port DXKeeper shows in that panel's heading. NOTE: Tooltip. {0} is the English menu path inside DXKeeper (DxKeeperConfigPath) and must stay untranslated, because DXKeeper's own interface is English-only.

data.name: DxKeeperConfigPath
data.value: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service > Base Port
data.comment: EN: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service > Base Port NOTE: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. Translating it would describe a menu that does not exist. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.

data.name: DxKeeperPortReading

data.comment: EN: Language: NOTE: Label for the user-interface language selector.

data.value: Jazyk tohoto okna. "Postupujte podle Windows" používá zobrazovací jazyk Windows. Změna nabude účinnosti, až příště začne brána.
data.comment: EN: Language of this window. "Follow Windows" uses the Windows display language. A change takes effect the next time the gateway starts.

data.name: LanguageFollowWindows
data.comment: EN: Follow Windows NOTE: First entry of the language list, meaning "use the Windows display language".

data.name: LanguageRestartNote
data.value: Restartovat bránu pro přepnutí rozhraní na {0}.
data.comment: EN: Restart the gateway to switch the interface to {0}. NOTE: Shown as a dialog and logged when the language is changed. {0} is a language name, already written in its own language - do not translate it. Deliberately one sentence ending in the placeholder: as "Language set to {0}. Restart the gateway to apply it." the machine pass dropped the ". " that followed the placeholder, producing "espanolReinicie" and "cestinaObnovit" - two sentences run together. Keep the placeholder at the end.

data.name: AlertMulticastRejected
data.comment: EN: {0} - starting WITHOUT multicast. NOTE: {0} is ErrNotAnIpAddress or ErrNotMulticast. The emphasis on "without" matters: the gateway looks healthy but would receive nothing from that group.

data.name: AlertUdpPortReverted
data.comment: EN: Reverted to UDP port {0}.

data.name: AlertMulticastReverted
data.comment: EN: Reverted the multicast group to "{0}". NOTE: {0} may be empty, meaning no multicast.

data.name: AlertReplaceNoKey
data.value: contactreplace pro {0}: není použitelné <oldcall>/<oldtimestamp> - úprava nebyla použita DXKeeper
data.comment: EN: contactreplace for {0}: no usable <oldcall>/<oldtimestamp> - the edit was NOT applied to DXKeeper NOTE: "contactreplace", "<oldcall>" and "<oldtimestamp>" are wire-format names - do not translate them. {0} is a callsign.

data.name: AlertDeleteNoKey
data.value: contactdelete pro {0}: chybějící volací znak nebo časové razítko - nic nebylo zasláno DXKeeper
data.comment: EN: contactdelete for {0}: missing callsign or timestamp - nothing was sent to DXKeeper NOTE: "contactdelete" is a wire-format name - do not translate it. {0} is a callsign.

data.name: AlertInternalError
data.value: INTERNÍ ZPĚTNÝ ZPĚT ZPRÁVY ({0}: {1}) - viz ErrorLog.txtBrána stále běží.
data.comment: EN: INTERNAL ERROR handling a message ({0}: {1}) - see ErrorLog.txt. The gateway is still running. NOTE: A defect in this program, not bad input. {0} is an exception type name and {1} its message - do not translate either. The last sentence matters: it tells the operator not to restart mid-contest.

data.name: AlertInvalidMessage
AlertReplaceLostQso
data.value: *** {0}: DXKeeper DELETED originál, ale nezapsal editaci{1} - editované QSO je v {2}, importovat. Důvod: {3}
data.comment: EN: *** {0}: DXKeeper DELETED the original but did not log the edit{1} - the edited QSO is in {2}, import it. Reason: {3} NOTE: The most serious message this program emits: DXKeeper no longer holds the QSO at all. Keep the *** marker. {0} callsign, {1} an optional " (TCP 52001)" tag, {2} a filename, {3} a reason from the Fail* strings.

data.name: AlertReplaceLostQsoNotSaved
data.value: *** {0}: DXKeeper DELETED originál, editace nebyla zaznamenána{1}, A editace nemohla být uložena {2}. Důvod: {3}
data.comment: EN: *** {0}: DXKeeper DELETED the original, the edit was not logged{1}, AND the edit could not be saved to {2}. Reason: {3} NOTE: As AlertReplaceLostQso, but the recovery file could not be written either - the QSO is unrecoverable. Keep the *** marker.

data.name: AlertNotConfirmed
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper did not confirm {0}{1}{2}: {3} NOTE: {0} a short description of the QSO, {1} an optional " (TCP 52001)" tag, {2} AlertSavedTo or AlertNotSavedTo or empty, {3} a reason from the Fail* strings.

data.name: AlertSavedTo
data.comment: EN: - saved to {0} NOTE: Fragment appended inside AlertNotConfirmed. Keep the leading space. {0} is a filename.

data.name: AlertNotSavedTo
data.comment: EN: - AND it could not be saved to {0} NOTE: Fragment appended inside AlertNotConfirmed. Keep the leading space. {0} is a filename.

data.name: FailBusy
data.comment: EN: another send had not finished yet NOTE: Deliberately plain. This read "another send was already in flight" and machine-translated into German as a literal statement about aviation - see the note on idioms at the top of this file.

data.name: FailConnectTimeout
data.value: připojení k DXKeeper Časováno po {0} sekund
data.comment: EN: the connection to DXKeeper timed out after {0} seconds NOTE: {0} is a number of seconds.

data.name: FailConnectRefused
data.value: nelze připojit k DXKeeper n TCP přístav {0}; v DXKeeperZkontroluj to. {1} zprávy "Listening"
data.comment: EN: cannot connect to DXKeeper on TCP port {0}; in DXKeeper, check that {1} reports "Listening" NOTE: {0} is a port number. {1} is DxKeeperConfigNetworkService, an English menu path inside DXKeeper - it must stay untranslated because DXKeeper's own interface is English-only.

data.name: FailNoPeerClose
data.value: DXKeeper nikdy nezavřel spojení uvnitř {0} sekund, takže QSO možná nikdy nebyl přijat
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper never closed the connection within {0} seconds, so the QSO may never have been accepted NOTE: {0} is a number of seconds. DXKeeper acknowledges only by closing the connection, so no close means the QSO cannot be claimed as delivered.

data.name: FailShuttingDown
data.value: Brána se vypnula a tohle nikdy neposlali.
data.comment: EN: the gateway was shutting down and this was never sent

data.name: FailSendFailed
data.comment: EN: the send failed NOTE: Last-resort wording when no more specific reason is available.

data.name: TrayShow
data.comment: EN: Open the gateway window NOTE: Notification area menu entry that brings the window back. Also the double-click action. Phrased as a full instruction rather than "Show gateway", which machine-translated into German as "Schaufenster" (a shop window) - a bare verb-noun pair gives a translator nothing to disambiguate against.

data.name: TrayQuit
data.comment: EN: Quit the gateway NOTE: Notification area menu entry that shuts the gateway down. Not the bare word "Quit", which machine-translated into German as "Quittung" (a receipt), Japanese as "login" and Korean as nonsense. Naming the object gives the model something to work with.

data.name: TrayHiddenTitle
data.comment: EN: Still running NOTE: Title of the notification shown the first time the window is minimised to the notification area.

data.name: TrayHiddenMessage
data.value: Brána stále přijímá QSOTady. Double- klikněte na tuto ikonu a přineste okno zpět.
data.comment: EN: The gateway is still receiving QSOs here. Double-click this icon to bring the window back. NOTE: Shown once per session. It matters: an operator who thinks they closed the gateway would stop watching for problems while it is still the only thing logging their contest.

data.name: TrayReceived
data.comment: EN: Received from N1MM: {0} NOTE: Count of UDP datagrams received. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayLogged
data.comment: EN: Logged to DXKeeper: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs DXKeeper confirmed. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayQueued
data.comment: EN: Waiting to send: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs queued behind the one in flight. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayNotDelivered
data.comment: EN: NOT delivered: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs DXKeeper did not confirm. Menu entry. The emphasis is deliberate - this is the number that needs acting on.

data.name: TrayAllDelivered
data.comment: EN: All QSOs delivered NOTE: Menu entry shown instead of TrayNotDelivered when nothing has failed.

data.name: TrayLastQso
data.comment: EN: Last QSO: {0} NOTE: {0} is a callsign and time, e.g. "W1AW 14:32". Menu entry.

data.name: TrayNoQsoYet
data.comment: EN: No QSOs yet

data.name: TrayOpenFailedFile
data.comment: EN: Open the undelivered QSO file NOTE: Menu entry that opens FailedQSOs_*.adi.

data.name: TrayFailureTitle
data.comment: EN: QSO not delivered NOTE: Title of the notification raised when DXKeeper does not confirm a QSO while the window is hidden.

data.name: TrayFailureMessage
data.value: DXKeeper není potvrzeno {0} QSOJe to sezení. Jsou uloženy pro vás import ručně.
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper has not confirmed {0} QSOs this session. They are saved for you to import by hand. NOTE: {0} is a count. Raised while the window is hidden, because the operator cannot see the warning bar then.

data.name: TrayTooltip
data.comment: EN: Received {0}, logged {1}, not delivered {2} NOTE: Tooltip under the product name. Windows caps the whole tooltip at 127 characters and it is truncated past that, so keep this short.

data.name: DxKeeperConfigNetworkService
data.comment: EN: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service NOTE: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.
